# Gate measurements

<!-- generated by ./gate.sh bench (scripts/gate_metrics.py); do not edit -->

Wall-clock cost of each gate arm, measured on the host below. `Before` is the raw command this repository documented before `./gate.sh` existed; `After` is the same work dispatched through the gate. These are records, not budgets: one run each, back to back, so the second run of a pair also inherits whatever the first warmed (the JAX compilation cache in `test/conftest.py` dominates this). Differences in either direction are that warmth plus machine noise, not the dispatcher.

## Unmeasured arms

`package` and `bench` are build/lifecycle arms rather than timed suites: `package` builds the sdist and wheel, installs the wheel into a throwaway environment and imports it from outside the source tree; `bench` is this page's producer. `notebooks-nightly` runs the nightly notebook tier and is scheduled separately. `all` is the concatenation of `lint`, `test`, `gnn`, `docs` and `notebooks`.
